items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I understand it was Bernstein, but he didn't want--you know, he didn't want--a lot of times people don't want being known that you are a Jew. So I understand he changed it to Burns.

ctx.x: No, you didn't tell me that, but first, you did tell me Herb Burns' name was something else.
I understand it was Bernstein, but he didn't want--you know, he didn't want--a lot of times people don't want being known that you are a Jew. So I understand he changed it to Burns.
Harry Burns, National Orchestra Service of New Orleans; and he booked a date or two for me after I few months I heard from him.
